channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Updates Contact Information for Estates and Asset Management Team
item.description: Residents can now access updated contact details for the Estates and Asset Management Team on the Rochdale Borough Council website, streamlining inquiries related to property management.

item.title: Live Bus Departures Available at Rochdale Road / Oldham College Stop
item.description: Live departure information for bus services 402, 409, and 76 can now be accessed at the Rochdale Road / Oldham College bus stop, providing real-time updates for commuters.

item.title: M62 Reopens After Sheep Incident Between Rochdale and Huddersfield
item.description: The M62 motorway has reopened in both directions between Junction 21 Rochdale and Junction 23 Huddersfield following an incident involving sheep on the carriageway. Residual delays remain as traffic returns to normal.

item.title: Wildfire emergency alert: an overreaction, or a sign of things to come?
item.description: Millions of phones across England and Wales sounded a Government Emergency Alert as wildfire risk reached exceptional levels. Was the intrusive warning proportionate, or are Britons being introduced to a hazard we will increasingly have to live with?

item.title: Homelessness, addiction and the cruelty of public condemnation
item.description: A disabled homeless man outside Tesco Express on Whitworth Road has become the subject of photographs, insults and jokes online. The harder question is whether public humiliation solves anything at all.

item.title: URGENT: Police appeal to find missing 10-year-old Rayah in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has launched an urgent appeal to find 10-year-old Rayah, who was last seen on Bower Avenue in Rochdale at around 8.30am today.

item.title: Falinge Park Junior Parkrun Set for Sunday at 9am
item.description: The Falinge Park Junior Parkrun will take place this Sunday at 9am, featuring activities and goodies for families with children aged 4 to 14.

item.title: Rochdale businesses urged to back Denehurst House in £30-a-month veterans challenge
item.description: A Rochdale veterans support organisation is asking 100 local businesses to pledge £30 a month to help keep Denehurst House operational and support former service personnel in need.

item.title: Rochdale businesses urged to back Denehurst House in £30-a-month veterans challenge
item.description: Get Together After Serving CIC is calling on 100 local businesses to pledge £30 a month to help keep Denehurst House operational and support veterans in need.

item.title: Police Appeal for Information on Missing Man James Last Seen in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police are appealing for information regarding a missing man, James, who was last seen on Albert Royds Street in Rochdale on August 4.

item.title: Thomas Heffron Sentenced to Nine Months for Grievous Bodily Harm
item.description: Thomas Heffron, 19, from Rochdale Road, Shaw, has been sentenced to nine months in prison after pleading guilty to grievous bodily harm at Manchester Minshull Street Crown Court.

item.title: Rochdale to Face Newport County in League Two Opener on Saturday
item.description: Rochdale will begin their Sky Bet League Two campaign against Newport County at Rodney Parade on Saturday, August 14, 2026, with kick-off scheduled for 12:30pm.

item.title: Annual Awareness Day Highlights Adult Care's Sensory Services at Number One Riverside, Rochdale
item.description: Residents explored adult care's sensory services during the annual awareness day at Number One Riverside, providing valuable information and advice.

item.title: Rail Replacement Services Operate Between Manchester Victoria and Rochdale
item.description: Two rail replacement services are currently running between Manchester Victoria and Rochdale, operated by Northern, following a recent operational review.

item.title: Wardle Library to Close on 17th August Due to Staffing Issues
item.description: Wardle Library will be closed on Monday 17th August due to a lack of staffing resources, with plans to reopen on Tuesday 18th August at 9am.

item.title: Seven Rochdale Schools to Offer Free Breakfasts from September
item.description: Seven local schools in Rochdale have successfully applied to the national breakfast club programme, allowing more children to access free breakfasts before school starting this September.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Achieves Joint 3rd Place in National Cycle Training Participation
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council ranks joint 3rd in the UK for cycle training participation among Year 6 students, with 84% accessing training in 2025/26, according to Bike Right.

item.title: Police Seek Information on Wanted Man Oliver Hill-Patterson in Rochdale and Heywood Areas
item.description: Greater Manchester Police are appealing for information regarding Oliver Hill-Patterson, who is wanted in connection with an assault and criminal damage. He has links to Rochdale and Heywood.

item.title: Tram Services Suspended Between Oldham Mumps and Rochdale Town Centre from 17 to 28 August 2026
item.description: No trams will operate between Oldham Mumps and Rochdale Town Centre from 17 to 28 August 2026 due to essential repair work at Derker following a landslip in 2024.

item.title: Community Engagement on First Bus in Rochdale Highlights Local Aspirations
item.description: A recent initiative on the ‘Round Here’ First Bus in Rochdale allowed residents to share their views on community change and future aspirations with the Our Future group.

item.title: Andy Warhol Artwork Displayed in Rochdale
item.description: Rochdale Art Gallery has announced the acquisition of a notable artwork by Andy Warhol, enhancing its contemporary art collection and attracting visitors.

item.title: Service Changes on Rochdale Line Due to Planned Works from 15 to 28 August
item.description: Planned works on the Rochdale line will result in service changes this weekend, with further disruptions expected until 28 August. Passengers are advised to plan their journeys accordingly.

item.title: Paul Dawson, 37, Convicted of Animal Cruelty in Rochdale
item.description: Paul Dawson, 37, from Rochdale, has received a suspended sentence after being convicted of animal cruelty for neglecting his dog, Kano, who was found in a severely malnourished state.

item.title: Live Bus Service Updates Available at Tweedale Street, Rochdale
item.description: Real-time bus service updates are now accessible at Tweedale Street in Rochdale, providing essential information for local commuters.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Netball launched as Rochdale Netball Club joins Dale family
item.description: Rochdale Netball Club is becoming Rochdale AFC Netball in a new partnership with Rochdale AFC and its Community Trust, bringing nearly 200 weekly players into the club's wider sporting family.

item.title: Police No Longer Treat Death of Woman Found at Milnrow Farm as Murder
item.description: Police have confirmed that they are no longer treating the death of a woman discovered after a fire at Higher Tunshill Farm in Milnrow as a murder investigation. Emergency services responded to the incident on July 3.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Signs Forward Adeeko
item.description: Rochdale have secured the signing of midfielder Baba Adeeko from Wigan Athletic on a one-year contract as they prepare for their League Two campaign.

item.title: Workington Town Ladies RLFC Players Receive New Boots Ahead of Charity Game Against Rochdale Hornets
item.description: Three players from Workington Town Ladies RLFC have received new boots from New Balance Flimby in preparation for their charity match against Rochdale Hornets this Sunday at Fibrus Community Stadium.

item.title: Number 83 Bus Services Cancelled Due to High Temperatures
item.description: The number 83 bus services will be cancelled until after 9pm this evening due to operational issues caused by high temperatures. Ticket acceptance is in place on tram services along the Rochdale via Oldham line.

item.title: Iraqi Consul General Meets Rochdale Mayor to Strengthen Ties
item.description: The Iraqi Consul General visited Rochdale Borough Council on August 13, 2026, to meet with the Mayor, aiming to enhance diplomatic relations and community engagement.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Launches New Netball Initiative to Boost Women's Participation in Sport
item.description: Rochdale AFC has announced the launch of its new netball programme aimed at increasing participation among women and girls in the borough. The initiative is expected to engage over 150 participants.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Launches New Netball Team for Women and Girls
item.description: Rochdale AFC has announced the launch of a new netball initiative aimed at increasing participation among women and girls in the sport across the borough.

item.title: Rochdale Feel Good Festival Attracts Thousands to Town Centre
item.description: The Rochdale Feel Good Festival, held on 8 August 2026, drew large crowds to the town centre, featuring performances from popular artists and local talent.

item.title: Action Together Achieves Volunteer Centre Quality Accreditation in Rochdale
item.description: Action Together has been awarded the Volunteer Centre Quality Accreditation (VCQA) for the first time in Rochdale, recognising its commitment to volunteering and community support.

item.title: Lift at Derker Tram Stop Out of Service Until Further Notice
item.description: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers. Step-free access is available via alternative routes.

item.title: LIVE: Woman arrested on suspicion of murder after 31-year-old man dies in Rochdale
item.description: A 37-year-old woman has been arrested on suspicion of murder after a 31-year-old man died at an address in Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale Hornets Wheelchair Rugby League Squad Set for Double Header Against Castleford Tigers
item.description: The Rochdale Hornets Wheelchair Rugby League Squad will face Castleford Tigers in a double header this Saturday, with free entry for supporters.

item.title: A-Level results day: Rochdale students discover what comes next
item.description: Students across Rochdale are receiving their A-Level results today, as the town's sixth form record comes under the spotlight and Rochdale MP Paul Waugh begins his new role at the Department for Education.

item.title: National Highways Announces £7.96bn Tender Opportunity for Rochdale Businesses
item.description: A significant procurement opportunity from National Highways is set to benefit Rochdale businesses, with a £7.96 billion tender for maintenance and renewal work across England's strategic road network.

item.title: Burnley Man Banned from Keeping Animals for 15 Years After Dog Found Neglected in Rochdale
item.description: Paul Lewis Dawson, 37, has received a 15-year ban on keeping animals after admitting to animal welfare offences involving his dog, Kano, found in poor condition at a Rochdale property.

item.title: Bluebird Care Rochdale Sponsors Added Time at Home Matches
item.description: Bluebird Care Rochdale has been announced as the added time sponsor for Rochdale AFC for the upcoming 2026/27 season, marking a new partnership between the homecare service and the football club.

item.title: Eclipse May Affect Night Shift Start Times for Rochdale Workers
item.description: Experts have warned that an upcoming eclipse could lead to a premature start for night shifts among workers in Rochdale, potentially disrupting schedules and routines.

item.title: Netwalk Event at Hollingworth Lake Draws Local Participants
item.description: A recent Netwalk event around Hollingworth Lake in Littleborough attracted a mix of new and familiar faces, fostering connections and conversations in a scenic setting.

item.title: Rochdale Valiant Launches New Media Portal for Local Community
item.description: Rochdale Valiant has introduced a new media portal aimed at providing contemporary news and information tailored for the local community.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to Host Open Training Session
item.description: Rochdale AFC will hold its annual Open Training Session at the Crown Oil Arena on Tuesday, 25th August, inviting fans to watch the team prepare for the upcoming season.

item.title: Bus Services Diverted Due to Roadworks on Shawfield Lane
item.description: Bus services in Rochdale are currently on diversion due to roadworks on Shawfield Lane, affecting routes 461, 437, and 447.

item.title: No trains between Rochdale and Manchester Victoria this week as replacement buses run
item.description: Passengers travelling between Rochdale and Manchester Victoria are being advised to allow extra time this week, with trains replaced by buses from Monday 10 to Friday 14 August.

item.title: £12m plan aims to bring Storage World Middleton site back to life after devastating fire
item.description: A £12m rebirth bid has been launched for the Storage World site in Middleton, more than a year after a devastating fire destroyed the Old Hall Street facility.

item.title: Summer makeover under way at St Mary’s CE Primary School in Rochdale
item.description: St Mary’s CE Primary School in Rochdale is undergoing a summer makeover, with improvement works taking place in the school hall and reception classroom ahead of the new term.

item.title: Can’t make it to church? Christ Church Healey invites community to join Sunday service online
item.description: Christ Church Healey is inviting people who cannot attend in person, are new to church or simply want to find out more to join its Sunday morning service online each week.
